text:
I had a very disappointing experience and would not recommend this clinic.

The organization at reception is extremely poor. I confirmed my appointment via WhatsApp multiple times (at least four times in writing), yet I still received messages asking if I was cancelling. This lack of coordination is frustrating and unprofessional.

More concerning, however, was the treatment itself. I booked with the expectation that a specialist would perform a root canal but the dentist did not even have the proper tools or equipment to carry out the procedure and told me this after he finished the procedure. This is completely unacceptable for a supposed specialist service.

The situation became much worse during the procedure. It felt like the dentist was unsure of what he was doing, and as a result, my tooth was damaged. I have now left with severe swelling and significant pain, which is deeply concerning.

Overall, this was a very negative experience—from disorganized administration to inadequate medical care. I strongly urge the clinic to address these serious issues.
